S.FORM: tmangux abax ginringan qa mbhkux payat kayal qani ga tmangux abax, garing saying byaling cyugal ski magal ryax ga t'aring qa tmangux abax qani. garing magal byaling magal ski pitu ryax gas i say maha tmsuqan qa tmangux abax qani la, tmangux abax laga si baqi maha sinpngan ryax qa gaga na sm'atu la Iyik qa tmangux abax qani, skura tltu qa cinbwanan qani ga nyan scobih hayi wagi, nyan si bnwan wagi krryax, ana kayal qani ga nyan mkilux uyi, nyan msqsya qa tlaka qani, baq hmor qsya qa llyung uyi. tmangux abax laga garing tmangux qabax abax ghoniq ro k'man uyi la, nyan si sphpah qa phpah qani, nyan sinhelax qabax qa qsinux qani, kpiyux sinbtwan qa qqsinux qani ga wayal sbatu uyi la. qbhniq qani ga shri plkan binah na˙san, musa skura tltu na rroq qa musa mbhuyax kya nanak, mllamu na qsinux qsinux ga twang qsliq smoya mipu, tliqan kilux qa kayal ro piny'ugan na cinbwanan qani ga nyan maga; pin'yugan "inlungan" na cquliq ki pin'aaray yaw na hi ta uyi.
S.PHON: tmaŋux aβax ɣinriŋan qa mβħkux pajat kajal qani ɣa tmaŋux aβax ɣariŋ [s|ɕ]ajiŋ βjaliŋ [ʦ|ʨ]juɣal [s|ɕ]ki maɣal rjax ɣa tʔariŋ qa tmaŋux aβax qani ɣariŋ maɣal βjaliŋ maɣal [s|ɕ]ki pitu rjax ɣa[s|ɕ] i [s|ɕ]aj maħa tm[s|ɕ]uqan qa tmaŋux aβax qani la tmaŋux aβax laɣa [s|ɕ]i βaqi maħa [s|ɕ]inpŋan rjax qa ɣaɣa na [s|ɕ]mʔatu la ijik qa tmaŋux aβax qani [s|ɕ]kura tltu qa [ʦ|ʨ]inβwanan qani ɣa njan [s|ɕ][ʦ|ʨ]oβiħ ħaji waɣi njan [s|ɕ]i βnwan waɣi krrjax ana kajal qani ɣa njan mkilux uji njan m[s|ɕ]q[s|ɕ]ja qa tlaka qani βaq ħmor q[s|ɕ]ja qa lljuŋ uji tmaŋux aβax laɣa ɣariŋ tmaŋux qaβax aβax ɣħoniq ro kʔman uji la njan [s|ɕ]i [s|ɕ]pħpaħ qa pħpaħ qani njan [s|ɕ]inħelax qaβax qa q[s|ɕ]inux qani kpijux [s|ɕ]inβtwan qa qq[s|ɕ]inux qani ɣa wajal [s|ɕ]βatu uji la qβħniq qani ɣa [s|ɕ]ħri plkan βinaħ na*[s|ɕ]an mu[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]kura tltu na rroq qa mu[s|ɕ]a mβħujax kja nanak mllamu na q[s|ɕ]inux q[s|ɕ]inux ɣa twaŋ q[s|ɕ]liq [s|ɕ]moja mipu tliqan kilux qa kajal ro pinjʔuɣan na [ʦ|ʨ]inβwanan qani ɣa njan maɣa pinʔjuɣan inluŋan na [ʦ|ʨ]quliq ki pinʔaaraj jaw na ħi ta uji
